Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose GF_SG_XREPLACE command on an MFNode field carries no value, causing a crash and denial of service when opened.

events.title: CVE-2026-134698
events.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() in src/filters/load_bt_xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF_ODUpdate command, causing gf_list_get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

events.title: CVE-2026-134699
events.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

events.title: CVE-2026-134700
events.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

events.title: CVE-2026-134701
events.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

events.title: CVE-2026-134702
events.summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

events.title: CVE-2026-134703
events.summary: libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an improper Unicode handling vulnerability in DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16 conversion functions in xmltok.c that can split valid surrogate pairs when output space is limited. In XML_UNICODE builds parsing non-native byte order UTF-16 input, attackers can supply crafted documents that deliver lone high surrogates to character data and default handlers.

events.title: CVE-2026-134704
events.summary: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

events.title: CVE-2026-134572
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /deleteAgent.php. The manipulation of the argument agent_id leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-134616
events.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /deleteClient.php. Such manipulation of the argument client_id leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-134623
events.summary: A flaw has been found in Microweber up to 2.0.20. This impacts the function UserManager::make_logged of the file src/MicroweberPackages/App/Http/Controllers/ApiController.php of the component Generic API Dispatcher. This manipulation causes improper access controls. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.21 will fix this issue. Patch name: e639d26e61b989b100f8b6f6bb78c0cecca79b99. You should upgrade the affected component.

events.title: CVE-2026-134651
events.summary: A flaw was found in Quay. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker holding a restricted, short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT) to achieve privilege escalation. Because Quay improperly accepts scoped registry bearer tokens as valid robot account passwords, an attacker can authenticate directly as the robot account and obtain broader permissions. Consequently, unauthorized access persists and enables the attacker to generate fresh tokens even after the robot account's password has been reset.

events.title: CVE-2026-105394
events.summary: The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster WordPress plugin before 1.4.0.7 does not restrict which origins it reflects into its cross-origin resource sharing response headers and pairs the reflected origin with credentialed access, allowing a page on a related origin to read a logged-in user's authenticated content across origins.

events.title: CVE-2026-107592
events.summary: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform any capability or nonce check in one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user with a minimal role such as Subscriber to change the publisher assigned to any book, including books created by other users, and to create new book records. The missing nonce check also makes the action exploitable via CSRF against any logged-in user.

events.title: CVE-2026-107593
events.summary: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX actions and protects it only with a nonce that it outputs to every authenticated user on all admin pages, allowing any logged-in user, including Subscribers, to trigger a site-wide rewrite of stored book purchase links and change a related Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 option.

events.title: CVE-2026-120413
events.summary: The Yoast SEO  WordPress plugin before 28.9 does not check that content is publicly viewable before returning its SEO metadata through a public REST endpoint, allowing unauthenticated users who know or can guess the URL of a private post, page or custom post type item to read its title, author, publication date and an excerpt of its content.

events.title: CVE-2026-123068
events.summary: The Front User Submit  WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not validate the content of files uploaded through one of its unauthenticated endpoints and later serves them back with a Content-Type derived from the file's bytes and an inline disposition, allowing unauthenticated attackers to store an HTML or SVG payload and obtain a same-origin URL that executes arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who opens it, including an administrator.

events.title: CVE-2026-123136
events.summary: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.2 does not check that the ticket type and price chosen through one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions belong to the event ticket later added to the cart, and stores them site-wide, allowing unauthenticated visitors to buy an event ticket at the lower ticket-type price configured on a different event.

events.title: CVE-2026-127024
events.summary: The WordForm  WordPress plugin before 4.1.6 does not properly validate uploaded files, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, including PHP, which leads to remote code execution.

events.title: CVE-2026-132814
events.summary: The WPO365 | SEAMLESS WORDPRESS + MICROSOFT INTEGRATION (WPO365 | LOGIN) WordPress plugin before 45.0 does not verify that a Microsoft ID token was issued for the site's own application and tenant when multi-tenant sign-in is enabled with an empty list of allowed tenants, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as an existing user, including an administrator, with a token Microsoft issued to an application they control.

events.title: CVE-2026-133362
events.summary: The ThinkRank SEO  WordPress plugin before 2.21.4 does not ensure that the settings section a request acts on is the section it was authorized for, allowing users granted access to only one ThinkRank SEO  WordPress plugin before 2.21.4 section by an administrator to read and update settings of other, more privileged sections, such as integration API keys and robots.txt content.

events.title: CVE-2026-14233
events.summary: The LifterLMS  WordPress plugin before 10.0.5 does not perform a capability or nonce check in one of its quiz-question query AJAX handlers, allowing any authenticated user with subscriber-level access to enumerate the titles of all published quiz questions, including those for courses they are not enrolled in.

events.title: CVE-2026-94259

events.title: CVE-2026-134748
events.summary: Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to evade Private Site mode via login page exemption. events.title: CVE-2026-134749
events.summary: MemberPress Members before 3.3.1, with the Block Permissions add-on enabled, contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated Author-level users to crash pages by saving a non-string blockPermissionsMessage block attribute. Attackers can store a JSON array in the attribute so wpautop() in get_block_replacement_content() throws a PHP 8 TypeError, causing fatal errors on post, home, search, and REST pages for unauthorized viewers.

events.title: CVE-2026-134750
events.summary: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read comments on role-restricted posts via the Latest Comments block. Attackers can view pages hosting the block, where get_the_ID() checks the host page and get_comment_excerpt() bypasses filtering, exposing restricted comments, post titles, and links.

events.title: CVE-2026-134751
events.summary: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read role-restricted posts by viewing Latest Posts blocks in full-content mode. The block renders raw post_content without firing the_content filter, bypassing members_content_permissions_protect() and exposing complete bodies of restricted posts.

events.title: CVE-2026-134752
events.summary: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete posts by abusing the delete action in wpgsi_show_view() without nonce verification. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into following a crafted wpgsi-show link with action=delete and an id parameter to delete arbitrary posts or pages.

events.title: CVE-2026-134753
events.summary: dsniff through 2.5a2 contains an integer underflow in decode_sniffer() in decode_sniffer.c that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write past the global obuf buffer. Attackers can send a UDP datagram to port 2001 on a monitored segment with a 4096-byte string, disabling base64_pton bounds checks to corrupt memory and crash dsniff.

events.title: CVE-2026-134754
events.summary: anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Decoder.readOneValue in bencode/decode.go that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying deeply nested bencode data. Attackers can deliver crafted .torrent files or magnet link metadata with millions of nested lists to cause a fatal stack overflow, or deeply nested v2 file trees to exhaust CPU.

events.title: CVE-2026-134755
events.summary: better-chatbot before 2.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that lets built-in tools run without user confirmation in Manual tool mode, because src/app/api/chat/route.ts keeps their execute handlers. Attackers can plant prompt-injected documents or web pages that make the HTTP request tool send conversation data to attacker-controlled URLs.

events.title: CVE-2026-134756
events.summary: Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition 2.39.0 before 2.45.1 contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability because user-supplied URLs are only syntax-checked by validate.IsURL without resolved address validation. Authenticated users can abuse Git cloning, Helm retrieval, registry ping, or the GitLab proxy to reach loopback, internal, and cloud metadata addresses, probing ports and reading responses.

events.title: CVE-2026-134757
events.summary: Anacrolix torrent before 1.63.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NewClient within tracker/http/client.go, which unconditionally sets InsecureSkipVerify to true for HTTPS trackers. Attackers able to intercept tracker traffic can impersonate trackers with any certificate, observe info_hash and peer_id values, and return forged peer lists.

When the links script and html printer are used, attacker-supplied href values close the unquoted anchor tag and execute JavaScript when the operator opens the report.

events.title: CVE-2026-132147
events.summary:
An arbitrary file read vulnerability was discovered in debbugs, a bug tracking system based on the active Debian BTS. versions.cgi failed to correctly sanitize package name inputs in found

and fixed query parameters. Crafted query parameters could cause version.cgi to output any lines of the target file which contained spaces.

events.title: CVE-2026-134624
events.summary: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

events.title: CVE-2026-134761
events.summary: libical before 4.0.7 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in icalparser_clean() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying truncated iCalendar input. Attackers can provide an iCalendar file or stream missing a matching END line, causing the returned component to be freed twice and crashing applications.

events.title: CVE-2026-134762
events.summary: ntop nDPI through 6.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and unsigned length underflow in ndpi_serializer_get_buffer() in src/lib/ndpi_serializer.c when stripping leading NUL and space bytes. Buffers holding only spaces or NULs, or a used length of 0 set through ndpi_serializer_set_buffer_len(), cause reads past the heap buffer or a wrapped 4294967295 length, crashing the embedding application.

events.title: CVE-2026-134763
events.summary: FreeRDP before 3.33.1 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the WinPR wLinkedList collection because LinkedList_FreeNode() frees nodes without updating the cached list->current enumerator pointer. When calling code removes the node the enumerator references, LinkedList_Enumerator_MoveNext() or LinkedList_Enumerator_Current() reads freed heap memory, which can crash the process.

events.title: CVE-2026-134764
events.summary: Ground Station before 0.8.25 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator operators to write files outside data/decoded via the post_process_pipeline value. Attackers can insert ../ sequences into a scheduled observation's IQ task configuration so SatDump creates directories, overwrites same-named files, and recursively deletes created trees on failure.

events.title: CVE-2026-134765
events.summary: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 contains a race condition in Kirby\Api\Upload::processChunk() that allows authenticated users with upload permission to bypass SVG sanitization. Attackers can race concurrent chunked uploads sharing a filename to swap a benign SVG with a script-bearing SVG, executing stored cross-site scripting in the site origin.

events.title: CVE-2026-134793
events.summary: Electerm before 5.9.0 on Windows contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute PowerShell code via crafted file or folder names containing Unicode quote characters. Attackers can deliver names containing U+2019 through archives, WSL distributions, or SMB shares, which break out of getFolderSizeWin() and calcLocal() quoting when victims request folder sizes, executing code as the electerm user.

events.title: CVE-2026-134794
events.summary: HedgeDoc before 1.12.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in the POST /history/:noteId endpoint that allows authenticated users to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ as the noteId. Attackers can send a pinned value to /history/__proto__, which historyPost() in lib/history.js assigns onto the prototype, crashing the Node.js process and causing denial of service for all users.

events.title: CVE-2026-134795
events.summary: graphql-core 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the parser max_tokens limit using long runs of comments. Attackers can submit GraphQL documents of consecutive comments that Lexer.lookahead fully tokenizes before limit checks, consuming CPU and memory proportional to document size.

events.title: CVE-2026-134796
events.summary: Donetick before 0.1.86 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the GET /api/v1/assets/*filepath route that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass URL signature checks by prefixing paths with profiles/. Attackers who know a private upload's storage key can request profiles/../users/<id>/<uuid>.<ext> to retrieve private attachments without a signature or login.

events.title: CVE-2026-134797
events.summary: Donetick before 0.1.86 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete other users' files by storing a crafted image value via PUT /api/v1/users. Attackers can set their image to a traversal key and upload a new profile photo, causing storage.Delete to remove other users' attachments or photos under the storage root.

events.title: CVE-2026-134798
events.summary: Donetick through 0.1.86 contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows self-registered users to make the server send requests by setting unvalidated circle webhook or Discord notification URLs. Attackers can point these URLs at loopback or internal services, causing EventsProducer and the Discord notifier to POST partly attacker-influenced bodies to internal network hosts.

events.title: CVE-2026-134799
events.summary: ByteStash 1.5.0 before 1.6.1 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /api/auth/oidc/callback handler because OIDC state is not bound to the initiating browser. Attackers can start an OIDC login with their own account and lure victims into opening the withheld callback URL, logging them into the attacker's account to read saved snippets.

events.title: CVE-2026-134800
events.summary: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because the POST /reset_password/passkey/end handler never calls endUserSessions(). Attackers holding a stolen session cookie keep authenticated access to the victim's account even after the victim recovers it by registering a new passkey.

events.title: CVE-2026-134801
events.summary: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an improper verification vulnerability that allows authenticated users to retain the emailVerified flag by changing their email address while EMAIL_VERIFICATION is disabled. Attackers with a previously verified account can set another person's address via the PATCH /email handler, receiving OIDC email_verified=true claims to impersonate that owner in relying applications.

events.title: CVE-2026-134802
events.summary: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade stricter ProxyAuth domain rules by sending percent-encoded path separators. Attackers can request paths with encoded slashes, backslashes, semicolons, or dot segments that match a broader rule, reaching restricted paths once the reverse proxy or backend decodes them.

events.title: CVE-2026-134803
events.summary: DBHub before 1.7.0 contains a read-only mode bypass vulnerability that allows MCP clients restricted to readonly execute_sql to run write and DDL statements via backslash-escaped quotes. Attackers can hide stacked statements that clear transaction_read_only or COMMIT inside strings misparsed by scanSingleQuotedString, letting them modify or drop MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL data.

events.title: CVE-2026-134804
events.summary: Portainer 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows Standard users to access other users' containers via the WebSocket attach and exec endpoints. Attackers with shared environment access can use leaked container or exec IDs to hijack sessions over /api/websocket/attach or /api/websocket/exec, gaining interactive root shells.

events.title: CVE-2026-134805
events.summary: Zipline before 4.8.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated OIDC users to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs via the userinfo picture claim. Attackers who control their picture claim at the identity provider can force fetchToDataURL() to request internal or cloud-metadata URLs and read responses from their stored avatar.

events.title: CVE-2026-134806
events.summary: Opencast before 20.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in WorkspaceImpl.toWorkspaceFile that allows authenticated ingest users to write files outside the workspace root via unvalidated element paths. Attackers can submit media packages whose element URIs or identifiers contain ../ sequences, causing Workspace.get to create directories and write fetched content with Opencast process privileges.

events.title: CVE-2026-134807
events.summary: Reposilite 3.5.27 before 3.6.7 contains a brute-force protection bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to evade login bans by spoofing the X-Forwarded-For header. Attackers can rotate the header value to make unlimited password or token guesses, or forge failed attempts to lock out legitimate clients.

events.title: CVE-2026-134808
events.summary: Gogs before 0.14.4 on Windows contains a path equivalence vulnerability in isRepositoryGitPath that allows authenticated users with write access to bypass .git directory protection using NTFS aliases. Attackers can create, rename or upload files via aliases like git~1 or .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION to overwrite .git/config or hooks and execute commands as the Gogs process.

events.title: CVE-2026-134809
events.summary: OpenOLAT 20.2.2 before 20.3.12, 21.0.0 before 21.0.7, and 21.1.0 before 21.1.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the TranscodingDeliveryDispatcher notifyResult callback endpoint. Unauthenticated attackers can POST crafted TranscoderJobResult JSON with attacker-supplied URLs to overwrite transcoded video and audio files and force server-side requests.

events.title: CVE-2026-134810
events.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a path traversal (zip slip) vulnerability in ImportService#unzip_photos_file that allows authenticated users to write files outside the extraction folder. Attackers can upload a crafted photos zip archive during account import with ../ entry names to create new files at arbitrary locations writable by the diaspora* process.

events.title: CVE-2026-134811
events.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in Notifier#invite that allows authenticated users to inject HTML or markdown into invitation emails through unescaped profile names. Attackers can set profile first or last names containing raw HTML, links, or images so invitation emails sent from the pod render spoofed content in recipients' mail clients.

events.title: CVE-2026-134812
events.summary: msgpackr before 2.1.4 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause denial of service by repeatedly re-decoding buffered incomplete values. Attackers can stream a large container of small elements in small chunks to UnpackrStream or decodeIter, triggering quadratic decoding cost that blocks the Node.js event loop.

events.title: CVE-2026-134813
events.summary: Faye websocket-driver 0.5.0 before 0.8.0, permessage-deflate before 0.2.0, and websocket-extensions before 0.2.0 contain a decompression bomb vulnerability because messages are fully inflated before maxLength is enforced. Unauthenticated remote clients negotiating permessage-deflate can send highly compressible messages, forcing processIncomingMessage() to allocate excessive memory and crash the server process.

events.title: CVE-2026-134814
events.summary: binary-parser before 2.3.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling parser definitions to inject JavaScript through string-typed options passed unvalidated by Context.generateOption(). Attackers can supply crafted length, lengthInBytes, key, tag, offset, or namely() alias values to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Node.js process when the parser is compiled.

events.title: CVE-2026-134815
events.summary: simple-git before 4.1.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the allowUnsafePack guard by supplying the --exec option to non-push git operations. Attackers who influence arguments passed to listRemote() or raw() can inject --exec for ls-remote, archive, fetch-pack or send-pack to execute commands on the host.

events.title: CVE-2026-134816
events.summary: sigstore-js @sigstore/oci before 0.8.0 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that leaks registry credentials by replaying OAuth2 password-grant request bodies on cross-origin 307 or 308 redirects. Attackers who can make a trusted token service redirect to their host via open redirect or compromise receive the username and password POSTed by RegistryClient.

events.title: CVE-2026-134817
events.summary: mcp-server-kubernetes before 4.2.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows remote MCP clients to inject kubectl flags by supplying dash-prefixed values as positional operands in tools such as exec_in_pod, kubectl_patch, and kubectl_logs. Attackers connected over SSE or Streamable HTTP transport can supply values like --filename to make kubectl read files from the server host, bypassing file-read restrictions.

events.title: CVE-2026-134818
events.summary: oasdiff 1.24.0 before 1.34.1 fails to enforce --allow-external-refs=false when --open is used, because the recordingReader() capture reader in load/capture.go never applies the external-reference policy. Attackers supplying an untrusted OpenAPI spec can use external $ref values to read local files or trigger HTTP requests, with contents uploaded in the review bundle.

events.title: CVE-2026-134819
events.summary: Delta Sharing reference server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows share recipients to read unshared data via container-scoped Azure SAS tokens. Recipients with a valid bearer token can request credentials from the temporary-table-credentials endpoint to read every blob in the storage container, including unshared tables.

events.title: CVE-2026-134820
events.summary: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI parser that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to desynchronize request framing by sending malformed framing headers. Attackers can send whitespace-padded Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length headers, signed Content-Length values, or invalid chunk terminators to smuggle requests past front-end proxies to the ASGI application.

events.title: CVE-2026-134821
events.summary: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

events.title: CVE-2026-134822
events.summary: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting mis-parsing in CheckSignature() of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. Attackers can append data after an extra '=' in RelayState of an intercepted or replayed Redirect-binding message, causing applications to trust the tampered value.

events.title: CVE-2026-134823
events.summary: Kitty 0.43.0 before 0.51.0 contains a terminal escape sequence injection vulnerability that allows attackers to emit escape sequences by crafting malicious file or archive member names. When a victim highlights such an entry in the choose-files kitten preview panel, unsanitized names are written raw, enabling OSC 52 clipboard overwrites, OSC 8 links, window title changes, or screen spoofing.

events.title: CVE-2026-134824
events.summary: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.98 contains a link following vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to read host files by setting --eventpath in an untrusted project .actrc to a symlink. Attackers can commit an event.json symlink pointing to files like ~/.ssh/id_rsa, which act copies into the job container as GITHUB_EVENT_PATH for workflow steps to exfiltrate.

events.title: CVE-2026-134825
events.summary: Gradio 6.27.0 before 6.32.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in gradio/history.py that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to use the operator's locally saved Hugging Face token by sending a forged Host: localhost header. When ssr_mode is enabled, requests proxied through the local Node SSR server pass the loopback check, letting attackers call run history endpoints to list buckets, read records and assets, and write buckets under the operator's account.

events.title: CVE-2026-134826
events.summary: erxes before 3.4.14 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the insurance_api plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to create, overwrite or delete contract templates via GraphQL mutations. Attackers can inject HTML into templates rendered by headless Chromium during generateContractPDF to pull internal network content into PDFs and exfiltrate customer fields.

events.title: CVE-2026-134827
events.summary: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.

events.title: CVE-2026-134828
events.summary: Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.19.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the sanitize-svg function that allows authenticated users to bypass filtering through unescaped re-serialization. Attackers with file edit permission can upload SVGs using entity-encoded or CDATA-wrapped markup or attribute quote breakouts to execute JavaScript in the Penpot origin when victims open them.

events.title: CVE-2026-134829
events.summary: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

events.title: CVE-2026-134830
events.summary: Casdoor before 4.27.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in decodeSamlMessage that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by sending unbounded DEFLATE-compressed SAML messages. Attackers can send a small, highly compressed SAMLRequest or SAMLResponse to the /api/saml/logout/:owner/:application endpoint, which inflates to gigabytes and crashes or stalls the server.

events.title: CVE-2026-134831
events.summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read unpublished help center articles through the public portal API. Attackers can request archived articles by slug via the ArticlesController show actions or read draft translations exposed through associated_articles in article JSON responses.

events.title: CVE-2026-134832
events.summary: Vim 9.2.0405 before 9.2.1352 contains a security bypass vulnerability in expand_tag_fname() that allows attackers to evade 'tagsecure' URL checks by escaping URLs in tags file entries. Attackers can supply a crafted tags file in a cloned repository so that jumping to a tag makes netrw fetch an attacker-controlled URL leaking environment variable values.

events.title: CVE-2026-134833
events.summary: RSSHub before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b contains a domain validation bypass in the javdb routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to capture the operator's JAVDB_SESSION cookie. Attackers can pass an absolute javdb.com URL in the category parameter and set the domain query to a host they control, causing processItems to send the _jdb_session cookie there.

events.title: CVE-2026-134834
events.summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Nextcloud.get_file that allows authenticated recipe editors to write and delete files by using unsanitized recipe names in temporary paths. Attackers can set a recipe name containing ../ segments via PATCH /api/recipe/<pk>/ and request /api/get_recipe_file/<pk>/ to overwrite and remove .pdf files outside the temporary directory.

events.title: CVE-2026-134835
events.summary: Langfuse before 4.82.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows organization admins to target internal hosts by setting the GitHub Enterprise SSO baseUrl, which skips outbound-URL validation. Attackers can point baseUrl to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata addresses so user sign-ins trigger server requests carrying stored OAuth client credentials.

events.title: CVE-2026-134836
events.summary: Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability in isLocalRequest that attaches user credentials to lookalike hosts due to prefix-only origin checks. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted ?config= link pointing to a lookalike host, capturing bearer tokens or HTTP auth headers to read configuration and stored API keys, or modify them when the victim is an admin.

events.title: CVE-2026-134837
events.summary: Frappe before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows Dashboard Manager users to pollute Object.prototype by storing __proto__ keys in Dashboard Chart custom_options. When any user, including administrators, views a dashboard rendering the chart, Object.assign merges attacker properties into Object.prototype, altering Frappe desk client behavior for that session.

events.title: CVE-2026-134838
events.summary: Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

events.title: CVE-2026-134839
events.summary: Linkwarden before 2.17.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the archive upload handler that allows collection members with only add permission to modify other users' links. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/v1/archives/<linkId> to replace another user's stored screenshot, PDF, readable, or HTML archive with attacker-supplied content.

events.title: CVE-2026-134840
events.summary: HumHub before 1.19.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController actionNewMemberSearch and actionAdminUserSearch, which skip the checkGroupAccess check. A manager of any single group can query admin-user-search and new-member-search with another group's id parameter to enumerate members, including administrators.

events.title: CVE-2026-134859
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PLYImporter::LoadFace and PLYImporter::createFromeTriStrip that fails to validate face vertex indices against the vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file whose out-of-range indices cause GenVertexNormalsProcess::GenMeshVertexNormals to write normals outside the heap buffer, crashing the application or potentially enabling code execution.

events.title: CVE-2026-134860
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ReadFloat in ColladaLoader.cpp because accessor stride and offset bounds are checked only by ai_assert. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose animation accessor describes more values than its float_array holds to read past the array or dereference null, crashing the importing application.

events.title: CVE-2026-134861
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in glTFAsset.inl that allows attackers to corrupt memory via oversized glTF 1.0 accessor elements. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with VEC4 position or VEC3 index accessors to overflow heap or stack buffers during import, crashing applications.

events.title: CVE-2026-134862
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that uses NORMAL and TEXCOORD accessors without comparing their counts to the POSITION vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with shorter normal or texture coordinate arrays to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads and writes that crash the importing application.

events.title: CVE-2026-134863
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an invalid pointer dereference vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportEmbeddedTextures that derives the texture format hint without checking the strchr result. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with an embedded image mime type lacking a slash to crash the importing application.

events.title: CVE-2026-134864
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that builds TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN faces from unfilled faces. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file whose strip or fan primitives trigger out-of-bounds reads or null pointer dereferences, crashing the importing application.

events.title: CVE-2026-134865
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ColladaParser::CopyVertex that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying primitives lacking a VERTEX input. Attackers can provide a crafted Collada file whose SIZE_MAX per-vertex offset bypasses the release-removed ai_assert check, crashing the importing application.

events.title: CVE-2026-134866
events.summary: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SkipLine that allows attackers to hang parsing by supplying files with '#' comment lines. Attackers can provide crafted OFF, LWS, or MD3 shader files so ReadFile never returns, consuming a CPU core and denying service.

events.title: CVE-2026-134867
events.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in FBXConverter::GetRotationKeyframeList that allows attackers to exhaust memory via unbounded rotation angle differences. Attackers can supply a crafted FBX file of about 111 KB whose keyframe interpolation loop never advances, consuming gigabytes of memory until the importing process is killed.

events.title: CVE-2026-134868
events.summary:
Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ColladaParser::ReadPrimitives that allows attackers to exhaust memory via non-numeric index values. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose

index list contains a non-digit character, causing endless zero-index appends until the importing process crashes.

events.title: CVE-2026-134730
events.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in xuxueli xxl-job 3.5.0/3.5.1-SNAPSHOT. The affected element is the function insert/update of the file admin/src/main/java/com/xxl/job/admin/business/controller/JobGroupController.java of the component Group Management. The manipulation of the argument addressList leads to cross-site request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134731
events.summary: A vulnerability was detected in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /insertClient.php. The manipulation of the argument client_id results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-134732
events.summary: A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function ASEImporter::InternReadFile of the file code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp of the component ASE File Importer. This manipulation causes out-of-bounds write. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 6.0.6 mitigates this issue. Patch name: 7ccc44a338dcdcc81023484388126ab1a8250e94. You should upgrade the affected component.

events.title: CVE-2026-134733
events.summary: A vulnerability has been found in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file booking.php. Such manipulation of the argument venue_id leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-134734
events.summary: A vulnerability was found in Webkul Bagisto up to 2.4.13. Affected is the function RazorpayController::paymentSuccess of the file packages/Webkul/Razorpay/src/Http/Controllers/RazorpayController.php of the component Payment Gateway Success/Callback Controllers. Performing a manipulation results in insufficient verification of data authenticity. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.4.14 is able to address this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

events.title: CVE-2026-134735
events.summary: A vulnerability was determined in Webkul Bagisto up to 2.4.12. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Success of the file packages/Webkul/PayU/src/Http/Controllers/PayUController.php of the component Payu Payment Gateway. Executing a manipulation of the argument Status can lead to insufficient verification of data authenticity. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.4.13 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

events.title: CVE-2026-134779
events.summary: A weakness has been identified in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. The affected element is the function Assimp::ColladaLoader::CreateAnimation of the file code/AssetLib/Collada/ColladaLoader.cpp of the component Collada Loader. This manipulation of the argument mSize causes out-of-bounds write. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

events.title: CVE-2026-134780
events.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. The impacted element is the function Assimp::JoinVerticesProcess::ProcessMesh of the file code/PostProcessing/JoinVerticesProcess.cpp of the component PostProcessing JoinVerticesProcess. Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds write. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134781
events.summary: A vulnerability was detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function Assimp::PretransformVertices::BuildMeshRefCountArray of the file PretransformVertices.cpp. Performing a manipulation results in out-of-bounds write. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134782
events.summary: A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. This impacts the function Assimp::ColladaLoader::CreateMesh of the file code/AssetLib/Collada/ColladaLoader.cpp. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

events.title: CVE-2026-134783
events.summary: A vulnerability has been found in xuxueli xxl-job 3.5.0/3.5.1-SNAPSHOT. Affected is the function difyWorkflowJobHandler of the file xxl-job-executor-sample-springboot-ai/src/main/java/com/xxl/job/executor/jobhandler/AIXxlJob.java of the component AI Executor. The manipulation of the argument baseUrl leads to server-side request forgery. The attack may be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134784
events.summary: A vulnerability was found in DumbWareio DumbDrop up to ff8f813f493e89c7da056e7a3101ce2ef48e3960. Affected by this vulnerability is the function isPathWithinUploadDir of the file src/routes/files.js of the component Files API. The manipulation results in improper access controls. The attack may be launched remotely. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134785
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Bagisto MangoPay Payment Gateway up to c061edcc7973cb37a77a9f9ae523db170c3e28ed. Affected by this vulnerability is the function MangoPayStandardController::success of the file src/Http/Controllers/Shop/MangoPayStandardController.php of the component Success Callback. The manipulation leads to insufficient verification of data authenticity. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. This product follows a rolling release approach for continuous delivery, so version details for affected or updated releases are not provided.

events.title: CVE-2026-134786
events.summary: A vulnerability has been found in Xuxueli xxl-job 3.5.0/3.5.1-SNAPSHOT. The affected element is an unknown function of the file JobLogController.java of the component Job Termination Endpoint. The manipulation leads to incorrect authorization. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134787
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in code-projects Intern Record System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /department.sql. Such manipulation leads to file and directory information exposure. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-134788
events.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in warpdesign pcx-js up to 1.1.1. Affected is the function decode8bpp/decode4bpp of the file js/pcx.js of the component PCX Pixel Buffer Decoder. Performing a manipulation results in uncontrolled memory allocation. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134789
events.summary: A weakness has been identified in DumbWareio DumbAssets up to 1.0.11. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file server.js of the component Settings API. Executing a manipulation of the argument appriseUrl can lead to dynamically-determined object attributes. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-129830
events.summary: When the rsyslog's `imuxsock` is parsing the TAG field from a message with a accepted shorter timestamp, the cursor used to read the message fields and the remaining message length to be read are left in a inconsistent state in relation to the content in the raw message, leading the module to read one byte past the end of the buffer holding the message.

events.title: CVE-2026-134850
events.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in aceberg WatchYourLAN up to 2.1.4. Affected by this issue is the function getPortState of the file backend/internal/api/api-network.go of the component Web API. The manipulation of the argument addr leads to server-side request forgery. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134851
events.summary: A vulnerability was detected in leonkhoo123 self-hosting-file-uploader up to 473e38ff8fba494f33a485730c6d95c5d8c536ea. This affects an unknown part of the file routes/generator.js of the component Admin Generator API. The manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack may be performed from remote. This product utilizes a rolling release system for continuous delivery, and as such, version information for affected or updated releases is not disclosed.

events.title: CVE-2026-134852
events.summary: A flaw has been found in shaozilee bmp-js up to 0.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function BmpDecoder.parseRGBA of the file lib/decoder.js. This manipulation causes uncontrolled memory allocation. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

events.title: CVE-2026-134853
events.summary: A vulnerability has been found in vthibault tga-js up to 1.1.1. This issue affects the function _decodeRLE of the file src/tga.js of the component TgaLoader. Such manipulation leads to uncontrolled memory allocation. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

events.title: CVE-2026-134854
events.summary: A vulnerability was found in andreasgal node-wav up to 0.0.2. Impacted is the function decode of the file index.js of the component WAV Decoder. Performing a manipulation results in uncontrolled memory allocation. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.summary: A vulnerability was determined in kchapelier qoijs 1.0.0. The affected element is the function decode of the file src/decode.js of the component QOI Decoder. Executing a manipulation of the argument arrayBuffer can lead to uncontrolled memory allocation. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. events.title: CVE-2026-134856
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Snes9x up to 1.63. The impacted element is the function S9xUnfreezeFromStream of the file snapshot.cpp of the component Save-State Screenshot Restoration. The manipulation leads to out-of-bounds read. The attack must be carried out locally. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

events.title: CVE-2026-121480
events.summary: Insufficient authorization in personal notification rules in Checkmk <2.5.0p20, <2.4.0p41 and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows authenticated users to receive notifications for hosts and services they are not a contact of by defining broad personal notification rules.

events.title: CVE-2026-115232
events.summary:
In iceoryx2 versions from 0.6.0 to 0.10.0, The C API getters that copy a service's hash into a caller-provided buffer (e.g. iox2_port_factory_pub_sub_service_hash and its other messaging protocol counterparts) write one byte past the end of the caller's buffer when `buffer_len` is less or equal to 40. The out-of-bounds byte is the string's NUL terminator, written at `buffer[buffer_len]`.



Resolution:



Resolution



The bugfix is released with iceoryx2 version 0.10.1 and on main branch (commit 7ca14dd).



Please note that the language bindings for C/C++ and Python (including the iceoryx2-ffi-c crate) are not published to crates.io since they are a local development dependency.

events.title: CVE-2026-118887
events.summary: ZTE Z80 Ultra is affected by an unauthorized access vulnerability. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could result in an impact on integrity.

events.title: CVE-2026-120382
events.summary: An improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability in the OAuth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.1.1-42962-10, 7.2.1-69057-14, 7.2.2-72806-11, 7.3.2-86009-6, and 7.4.1-90080-2 allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

events.title: CVE-2026-121456
events.summary:
A privilege escalation vulnerability in the Axivion Suite ApiToken permission restriction for OIDC and SAML users of the Axivion Dashboard. 
When a user creates an ApiToken with a restricted token type (for example, IDE plugin or Continuous Integration), some of that user’s permissions should be removed from the token. For users who sign in to the Dashboard through OIDC, or through the SAML preview feature, this restriction has no effect. Exploitability is low: an attacker needs an ApiToken that has been leaked, or one that was shared on the assumption that its permissions were restricted.

events.title: CVE-2026-134881
events.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in HuLaSpark HuLa up to 3.0.9. This vulnerability affects the function showMsg of the file luohuo-cloud/luohuo-im/luohuo-im-biz/src/main/java/com/luohuo/flex/im/core/chat/service/strategy/msg/RecallMsgHandler.java of the component Recall Message Notification. The manipulation of the argument nickName results in cross site scripting. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134935
events.summary: The dell-xps-touchpad-haptics package before 1.0.0-4 for Omarchy allows local users to change ownership of a root-owned file by making their own .config/omarchy/dell-haptic.conf file a symlink to that target file.

events.title: CVE-2026-115873
events.summary: A remote attacker must authenticate with Read Only (GroupRead) access to at least one Worker Group and reach the Leader API. A crafted expression can exploit the nested compiler to bypass expression restrictions and execute code with the Leader service account's permissions.

events.title: CVE-2026-115899
events.summary: An attacker must control pagination data returned by an upstream API or service queried by an existing REST Collector. The Collector must use affected response-based pagination and process the crafted data during a job run. Successful exploitation executes code with the Worker service account's permissions.

events.title: CVE-2026-115900
events.summary: An attacker must possess a valid Worker distribution credential, reach the Leader distribution listener, and send crafted authenticated Worker heartbeats. Where mTLS client authentication is enforced, an accepted client certificate and its private key are also required. Successful exploitation bypasses Leader REST authentication and permits administrative API access.

events.title: CVE-2026-115901
events.summary: Exploitation requires an identity admitted to a configured trusted IdP application, control of claims selected as the OIDC user identifier, acceptance by configured SSO filters, and a victim with an active Cribl session following a crafted authentication link. Script executes in the Cribl origin, disclosing the victim's session token and permitting access with the victim's privileges; administrator access requires an administrator victim.

events.title: CVE-2026-115903
events.summary: An authenticated attacker must reach the Edge file APIs through the Leader or directly on an Edge node. On affected managed Edge deployments with RBAC, Read Only access permits these calls. Disclosure is limited to files readable by the Edge process under its operating-system permissions and capabilities.

events.title: CVE-2026-134882
events.summary: A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK A7100RU 7.4cu.2313_B20191024. This issue affects the function exportOvpn of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component CGI Handler. This manipulation of the argument Username causes os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely.

events.title: CVE-2026-93584
events.summary:
An SQL injection vulnerability in OTRS versions 2024.3.1 through 2026.8.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary SQL expressions through the Survey endpoint.

The vulnerability exists in the Kernel::System::Survey::Request::RequestGet() method, which directly incorporates an attacker-controlled survey key into a SQL query without using parameterized statements. Successful exploitation allows attackers to retrieve ticket information and perform boolean-based or time-based blind SQL injection to extract potentially sensitive data accessible to the OTRS database account. Exploitation does not require authentication, a valid survey key, or an existing survey request. The external frontend must be accessible.

events.title: CVE-2026-118888
events.summary: ZTE Z80 Ultra product has an improper access control vulnerability. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability may affect confidentiality.

events.title: CVE-2026-121613
events.summary: Missing authentication and authorization on an exposed interface allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to send arbitrary commands to the affected component, which can force a device reboot or let the attacker upload malicious firmware.

events.title: CVE-2026-128979
events.summary:
Improper certificate validation vulnerability in Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) libdigidocpp, Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc4, Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc on Android, and Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc on iOS.


The vulnerability occurs because libdigidocpp does not properly validate
 the Extended Key Usage (EKU) extension of certificates used to sign 
OCSP responses. Specifically, it fails to verify that the certificate 
contains the id-kp-OCSPSigning EKU, which identifies certificates 
authorised to sign OCSP responses. 





This issue affects libdigidocpp: from 3.10.0 before 4.5.2; DigiDoc4: from 4.0.0 before 4.11.2; DigiDoc: from 3.0.0 before 3.2.0; DigiDoc: from 3.0.1 before 3.2.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-134883
events.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in osCommerce 4.14.63493. Impacted is the function actionOrdersbatch of the file lib/backend/controllers/OrdersController.php of the component Orders Batch Processing. Such manipulation of the argument orders leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134884
events.summary: A vulnerability was detected in osCommerce 4.14.63493. The affected element is an unknown function of the component Backend Administration List Controller. Performing a manipulation of the argument order[0][dir] results in sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134885
events.summary: A flaw has been found in osCommerce up to 4.14.63493. The impacted element is the function actionSuccess of the file lib/frontend/controllers/MultisafeController.php of the component MultiSafepay Payment Success Callback. Executing a manipulation of the argument customer_id can lead to improper authentication. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-80466
events.summary: A vulnerability in the Web-Based Management (WBM) routing configuration allows a low-privileged remote attacker to inject shell commands into routing parameters. Due to insufficient input validation, these values are stored in a configuration file and later processed by a privileged root helper script.

events.title: CVE-2026-88850
events.summary: The Web-Based Management (WBM) authorization model does not properly enforce permissions for all PROFIBUS configuration operations. A low-privileged remote attacker can abuse an exposed configuration function to modify root-owned PROFIBUS parameters, including device addressing and SSA settings. This allows unauthorized changes to fieldbus-related configuration and violates the intended privilege boundaries within the management interface.

events.title: CVE-2026-94252
events.summary:
An unauthenticated stored and reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the embedded web interface of Frontier Smart Technologies Venice X FS2340 running IR4.9 allows a network attacker with access to the interface to inject attacker-controlled JavaScript that may execute in the browser of a user accessing affected content.



Successful exploitation may allow the attacker to access information available within the browser's security context or perform actions through the affected web interface with the privileges of the affected user.



During authorized security testing, certain crafted JavaScript and code-injection payloads were also observed to cause the embedded web interface to crash and become temporarily unavailable on some tested software versions. This behavior represents a denial-of-service condition affecting the embedded web management interface; no device-level denial of service was established.

events.title: CVE-2026-118889
events.summary: Z80 Ultra product has an improper access control vulnerability in the UI module. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability may affect confidentiality.

events.title: CVE-2026-123886
events.summary:
Spring Data Elasticsearch replaces positional placeholders in string-based @Query methods with the method arguments before it evaluates SpEL expressions in the resulting query string.



As a result, an argument that contains a SpEL expression is evaluated as part of the query, even if the declared query does not use SpEL.



 An application is affected if it passes untrusted input as an argument to a repository query method that declares a @Query with positional placeholders.



In that case, a remote attacker can execute arbitrary code in the application, and repeated requests can exhaust memory through the unbounded expression cache.

events.title: CVE-2026-124559
events.summary: A flaw was found in QEMU's NBD server. A remote attacker can crash a multi-export NBD server process by exploiting stale metadata export state during an extended BLOCK_STATUS request, resulting in an assertion failure and denial of service.

events.title: CVE-2026-125683
events.summary: A flaw was found in QEMU's NBD server. A remote attacker can crash qemu-nbd, qemu-storage-daemon, or qemu-system by sending NBD_OPT_SET_META_CONTEXT or NBD_OPT_LIST_META_CONTEXT with a declared option length exceeding the actual payload, triggering an assertion failure and denial of service.

events.title: CVE-2026-126657
events.summary: A flaw was found in QEMU's NBD block driver. A malicious NBD server can send an incomplete structured read reply marked as done, causing QEMU to return uninitialized host heap memory to the guest VM, resulting in host memory disclosure.

events.title: CVE-2026-133646
events.summary: Synchronet BBS, in versions 3.20b to 3.21e, contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the answer() function when processing the terminal attribute of the SSH service. The call to cryptGetAttributeString() does not limit the copy to the size of the destination buffer, of which 41 bytes are used. An unauthenticated remote client can send a TERM value of up to 64 bytes and overwrite adjacent fields of the session object. If the SSH service is enabled, this tampering can cause connection threads to be blocked for an extended period, even after the client has disconnected. By exhausting the available sockets, the attacker can prevent new connections and cause a denial of service requiring the software to be restarted.

events.title: CVE-2026-134886
events.summary: A vulnerability has been found in osCommerce up to 4.14.63493. This affects the function actionCached of the file lib/frontend/controllers/ImageController.php of the component Cached Image Handler. The manipulation of the argument image leads to path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134887
events.summary: A vulnerability was found in osCommerce 4.14.63493. This impacts the function get_address_book_data of the file lib/common/helpers/Customer.php of the component Account Address List Widget. The manipulation of the argument customers_id results in sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134888
events.summary: A vulnerability was determined in osCommerce 4.14.63493. Affected is the function CheckoutController::actionRestart of the file lib/frontend/controllers/CheckoutController.php of the component Checkout Order Restart. This manipulation of the argument order_id causes sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134889
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in osCommerce 4.14.63493. Affected by this vulnerability is the function updateAddress of the file lib/common/components/Customer.php of the component Address Book Handler. Such manipulation of the argument address_book_id leads to authorization bypass. The attack may be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-135055
events.summary: A flaw was found in the GLib DMA-BUF path of WebKitGTK. The UIProcess trusted fds.size() as the DMA-BUF plane count when handling AcceleratedBackingStore::DidCreateDMABufBuffer and copied offsets and strides without verifying that those vectors had the same length. A compromised WebProcess can send mismatched vector lengths, causing an out-of-bounds read in the privileged UIProcess. This can disclose UIProcess memory and crash the UIProcess, and may be used as part of a Web Content sandbox-escape chain.

events.title: CVE-2026-135094
events.summary: Missing authorization vulnerability in the "GetByProject" endpoint (/Project/{id}) of the VulnController in Cervantes version v1.3-beta could allow an authenticated attacker with VulnsRead permission to retrieve the vulnerabilities of any project, even without being a member of it, by supplying an arbitrary project ID.

events.title: CVE-2026-59340
events.summary:
PagePdfDocumentReader and ParagraphPdfDocumentReader are vulnerable to a denial of service when processing untrusted PDF input.



 The underlying text extraction logic reconstructs layout from a PDF's glyph positions and limits how much memory can be allocated for any single computed gap, but does not limit the cumulative allocation across an entire page.



A specially crafted PDF can exploit this to force excessive memory allocation during processing, resulting in OutOfMemoryError.



Depending on JVM configuration, this can cause request failures with degraded service under repeated exploitation, or immediate JVM termination when ExitOnOutOfMemoryError options are used.



Any application that processes PDFs from untrusted sources (document upload, email attachment processing, RAG ingestion, web crawling) using either affected reader is impacted.

events.title: CVE-2026-59442
events.summary:
TypesenseFilterExpressionConverter does not correctly translate grouped (parenthesized) filter expressions into the Typesense filter syntax.



As a result, the filter sent to Typesense can have a different meaning than the one the application defined, and some conditions may not be applied as intended.



 An application is affected if it uses the Typesense vector store with filter expressions that contain groups and relies on them to restrict results, for example to enforce tenant isolation or access control.



In that case, a remote user may be able to retrieve documents they should not have access to, and the same filter used for a delete operation may remove documents outside the intended scope.

events.title: CVE-2026-101282
events.summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.13, 11.10.x <= 11.10.3, 11.11.x <= 11.11.3 fail to mark the plugin configuration setting as secret in the plugin manifest, which allows anyone with access to a generated Support Packet to obtain third-party provider API keys and cloud service account credentials via the sanitized_config.json file.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00604

events.title: CVE-2026-134890
events.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in osCommerce 4.14.63493. Affected by this issue is the function save_products of the file lib/common/classes/extended/OrderAbstract.php of the component Order Placement. Performing a manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134891
events.summary: A weakness has been identified in osCommerce 4.14.63493. This affects the function actionGiftCard of the file lib/frontend/controllers/CatalogController.php of the component Virtual Gift Card Basket. Executing a manipulation of the argument products_id can lead to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-134892
events.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in SourceCodester Cosmetics and Beauty Product Online Store 1.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file admin/orders/view_order.php of the component Admin Order Management. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-134924
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in chillzhuang SpringBlade up to 5.0.2. This impacts the function AvueIframe of the file src/components/iframe/main.vue of the component Iframe Route Renderer. The manipulation of the argument url leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

events.title: CVE-2026-13408
events.summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.13 fail to verify that the requesting user has read permission for a post's channel which allows an authenticated user to read attachment-bearing posts from private channels and direct messages they cannot otherwise access via a crafted {{post_id}} in a POST request to {{/plugins/com.mattermost.mscalendar/action/respond}}. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00708

events.title: CVE-2026-19531
events.summary: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.13, 11.10.x <= 11.10.3, 11.11.x <= 11.11.3 fail to verify that the requesting user has file download permission under an ABAC policy before reading file content, which allows an authenticated channel member to obtain the contents of files they are denied access to via interactions with an Agent bot.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00759

events.title: CVE-2026-116001
events.summary:
NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in Apache Perl.



This issue affects Apache Perl: from 1.99_04 through 2.0.13.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.14, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-116005
events.summary:
Fixed-size stack buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache Perl.



This issue affects Apache Perl: from 1.99_01 through 2.0.13.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.14, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-116032
events.summary:
Stack buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache Perl.



This issue affects Apache Perl: from 1.99_01 through 2.0.13.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.14, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-116043
events.summary:
NULL pointer dereference, Out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Apache Perl.



This issue affects Apache Perl: from 1.99_01 through 2.0.13.



Also fixes an out-of-bounds read in per-request $/ save/restore for which CVE-2026-116021 (now rejected) had previously been assigned.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.14, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-116772
events.summary:
OOB read vulnerability in Apache Perl.



This issue affects Apache Perl: from 1.99_07 through 2.0.13.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.14, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-116799
events.summary:
OOB read vulnerability in Apache Perl.



This issue affects Apache Perl: from 1.99_01 through 2.0.13.



Note: The over-read data can be returned to the client in the response.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.14, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-125651
events.summary:
Cleartext storage in encrypted parquet file vulnerability in Apache Arrow Rust (`parquet` crate), from version 55.0.0 through to 57.3.2, 58.4.1, 59.3.2 and 60.1.0.



When writing an encrypted parquet file with a column with bloom filters, the header and bitsets of the bloom filter are written in plaintext in the final parquet.



Users are recommended to upgrade to versions 57.3.3, 58.4.2, 59.3.3 or 60.2.0 which fix the issue by raising an error when trying to write encrypted parquet files with bloom filters enabled, preventing such files from being written out.



Existing encrypted parquet files written with bloom filters are still vulnerable, and it is recommended to rewrite those files with bloom filters disabled if possible.

events.title: CVE-2026-134925
events.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in yangzongzhuan RuoYi up to 4.8.3. Affected is the function renderUserCards of the file ruoyi-admin/src/main/resources/templates/system/role/view.html of the component Role Management User-View. The manipulation of the argument Username results in cross site scripting. The attack may be launched remotely. The patch is identified as 04db82c3c85593921ab8be48a4b3016866eaa97e. It is best practice to apply a patch to resolve this issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-53672
events.summary:
A bug related to the Zookeeper HTTP endpoints in Apache Solr allows an authenticated attacker with zk-read permission to read /security.json, bypassing the security-read authorization check. This may cause unauthorized read of credential hashes and authorization configuration.

For this attack to be successful, the following must be true
  *  The system is secured with Solr's Basic Auth plugin
  *  The attacker has gained direct network access to the Solr cluster
  *  The attacker has obtained credentials for a user account with zk-read permission (which is recommended assigned to trusted admins only)


Users are recommended to upgrade to 9.11.0, 10.1.0 or a newer release.
Users who cannot upgrade immediately are recommended to assign the zk-read permission only to users who they entrust reading security.json.

events.title: CVE-2026-86312
events.summary:
Under some configurations a request to the ping endpoint could carry out more than a simple health check. In deployments that rely on Solr's rule-based authorization, a client granted only the low-privilege health permission could thereby trigger behavior that should require higher privileges; where the shipped security.json template leaves the health permission unauthenticated, no credentials are required at all. 


This issue affects Apache Solr from 9.0.0 through the releases preceding the fixed versions. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.11.0 or 10.1.0, which resolve the issue.




You are affected if you run an affected version and allow the /admin/ping endpoint to be reached with only the health permission. This includes the default sample security configuration installed by the bin/solr CLI, where that endpoint is unauthenticated.

Users who cannot upgrade immediately should restrict access to the /admin/ping endpoint in their authorization configuration — for example by requiring a trusted role for that path — and ensure Solr is not reachable from untrusted clients or networks, as recommended for all Solr deployments.

events.title: CVE-2026-119068
events.summary: An rsync server can send diagnostic data to the client which is mirrored to stdout and collected by Routinator line by line. If an excessive amount of data is sent without a line break, Routinator will eventually run out of memory and crash.

events.title: CVE-2026-119069
events.summary: When rejecting a publication point midway during processing amd falling back to the stored version of the publication point, Routinator will keep the data it had processed for the publication point so far rather than dropping it.

events.title: CVE-2026-132856
events.summary: A vulnerability was discovered in the ZoneAlarm client for Windows that allows a low-privileged local user to run code with SYSTEM privileges. An attacker must first be able to run code on the target system as a local user.

events.title: CVE-2026-134927
events.summary: A weakness has been identified in phpBB up to 3.3.19. Affected by this vulnerability is the function phpbb_get_user_rank of the file includes/acp/acp_ranks.php of the component Ranks Handler. This manipulation of the argument rank_image causes cross site scripting. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor confirms: "We have reviewed the report and intend to address the issue as part of our ongoing security hardening efforts. Given that exploitation requires authenticated administrative access, we consider this a low-priority issue. We will aim to include a fix in our next release and will notify you once it is available."

events.title: CVE-2026-93585
events.summary:
