events.title: CVE-2026-135151
events.summary: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.78 via the 'file[page_template]' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The malicious page_template value is stored when an Author creates or edits a package post, and the inclusion is triggered on any subsequent page view of the package permalink, meaning the include() can be fired by unauthenticated visitors after the payload is planted.

events.title: CVE-2026-135266
events.summary: The Music Player for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.4 via the '_downloadable_files' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. Staging the attack requires storing a crafted downloadable file URL against a product, which requires the edit_products capability (Shop Manager or above); however, triggering the file read via the ?wcmp-action=play handler is fully unauthenticated once the crafted URL is saved to a published product.

events.title: CVE-2026-133342
events.summary: Joomla Extension - joomdonation.com - Unauthenticated SQL injection in event registration in Events Booking < 5.12.0 - The event_id submitted through the public registration form was not cast to an integer before being added to an SQL query for the registration's custom fields, allowing unauthenticated SQL injection.

events.title: CVE-2026-135203
events.summary: In Eclipse Ditto versions 0.3.0-M1 through 3.8.15 and 3.9.0 through 3.9.9, the JavaScript payload mapper of the connectivity service executes user-supplied mapping scripts in a Mozilla Rhino engine without a ClassShutter. A mapping script can catch an engine error and use the Java exception object exposed on it to reach arbitrary Java classes and methods via reflection, bypassing the documented sandbox restriction that mapping scripts cannot access Java packages or classes. This allows a user permitted to create or modify connections (by default the Ditto DevOps realm) to execute arbitrary code in the connectivity service, gaining access to its credentials and to the Ditto cluster.

events.title: CVE-2026-115685
events.summary: In affected versions of Octopus Deploy, Unauthorized users can perform write actions on specific endpoints due to lack of permission checks.

events.title: CVE-2026-119630
events.summary: The Timetics – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data and user account creation in versions up to, and including, 1.0.67 This is due to the public `POST /wp-json/timetics/v1/bookings` route being registered with `permission_callback => function () { return true; }` and the handler (`create_item()` → `save_bookings()` → `booking_appointment()`) passing the attacker-controlled `email` directly into `Customer::make()`, which (a) grants the `timetics-customer` role to any existing WordPress user matched by email — including administrators and staff — and overwrites that account's `first_name`/`last_name` user meta, and (b) calls `wp_insert_user()` with role `timetics-customer` when the email is new, regardless of the site's `users_can_register` setting. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create arbitrary WordPress user accounts, assign the `timetics-customer` role to existing accounts (including administrators), and overwrite their profile metadata.

events.title: CVE-2026-120081
events.summary: The Duplicate Post plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data[custom][names][prefix]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the site owner to have enabled both 'User Level Permissions' for the Subscriber role and the 'Show reference to original item?' option, and the targeted administrator must view the edit screen of the chained copy post in the classic editor.

events.title: CVE-2026-120120
events.summary: The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_field_conditions[0][field]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The vulnerability requires a two-step exploit: a crafted field value must first be stored via the wp_ajax_automatorwp_update_item_option AJAX endpoint, and then the target automation must be triggered to fire the vulnerable SQL query.

events.title: CVE-2026-120570
events.summary: The Enfold theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'templateName' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The AJAX save handler validates a nonce and requires only the edit_posts capability, meaning a Contributor can legitimately obtain the nonce from their own post-edit screen and store a malicious template name that subsequently fires in every privileged user's session.

events.title: CVE-2026-122065
events.summary: The MoreConvert Wishlist for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'empty_icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is exploitable even in version 2.0.4 where a patch was attempted, because the sanitizer's single html_entity_decode pass combined with esc_attr()'s double_encode=false behavior leaves entity-encoded inner markup intact, which the counter JavaScript then decodes and assigns to innerHTML, turning inert encoded text back into executable DOM elements.

events.title: CVE-2026-123175
events.summary: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_text (shortcode attribute of [vc_cta])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The style="classic" shortcode attribute must be used to trigger the vulnerable code path that feeds custom_text through vc_get_css_color into the inline style attribute; wp_kses_post applied at save time does not neutralize the payload because the attacker's value contains no HTML tags, only a double quote inside a shortcode attribute, leaving the injected content intact in post_content.

events.title: CVE-2026-125293
events.summary: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'feed (title field inside the JSON-encoded feed array)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.24.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. sanitize_text_field() is applied on storage but strips only angle brackets and newlines, leaving single quotes and parentheses intact — the exact characters needed to break out of the onclick JavaScript string context constructed by wppfm_feedListTable() and installed via jQuery .append().

events.title: CVE-2026-128096
events.summary: The Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'acf[field_klzacffa_iconcls] (profile.php) / acf.profile_icon_class (REST)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable when the plugin is configured in FontAwesome 4.x or 5.x compatibility mode and the icon field's return format is set to 'Icon Class', which is the documented usage pattern for rendering icon classes in theme templates.

events.title: CVE-2026-128111
events.summary: The Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upload-file' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires that the targeted contact form be configured to accept a non-script extension such as .gpx (or any extension outside the HTML/XML/PHP blocklist), and the uploaded file is served without a Content-Type header, causing browsers to MIME-sniff and execute it as text/html.

events.title: CVE-2026-130036
events.summary: The WordClever – AI Content Writer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.5. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to overwrite and permanently destroy the administrator's license configuration, blanking the stored license key, setting the license status to inactive, and clearing the current plan — disabling the plugin's paid AI generation features site-wide.

events.title: CVE-2026-130045
events.summary: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[].value (XML-RPC wp.newPost -> post meta 'options' -> JSON->theme)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload is stored via the XML-RPC wp.newPost endpoint, which bypasses Admin_Controller::sanitize_options() entirely because the CPT inherits default 'post' capabilities, making any Author-level account sufficient to write the malicious 'theme' value.

events.title: CVE-2026-130050
events.summary: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[options] -> fields[].placeholder' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wof_lite_wheel custom post type inherits standard post capabilities due to an unset capability_type, meaning any Author-level user can publish a malicious wheel via XML-RPC in a single request, exposing every front-end page that renders the wheel to all visitors.

events.title: CVE-2026-130056
events.summary: The W4 Post List plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (for metakeyinput=<attacker-chosen key>)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the attacker's post to be included in the W4 Post List query and the active list template to reference the attacker's chosen meta key via a [post_meta key="..."] tag; because WordPress core applies no kses filtering to custom field values on save, a raw XSS payload is preserved in the database unmodified and rendered verbatim on every page load.

events.title: CVE-2026-131613
events.summary: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Business Directory & Classified Ads plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that the admin option 'post-for-unregister' is enabled (Functions::is_enable_post_for_unregister() returns true). On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with subscriber-level access and above.

events.title: CVE-2026-131688
events.summary: The Secure MCP Server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and other AI Agents plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.8 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for attackers (with access to a valid MCP bearer token) to escalate privileges to the token owner's Administrator role — bypassing NHI ability allow-list and scope restrictions entirely — by submitting any valid MCP bearer token (including scope-restricted connection-test tokens) to arbitrary WordPress endpoints such as admin-ajax.php. This requires possession of a valid MCP bearer token, which is routinely issued to any administrator who connects an MCP client to the site. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.

events.title: CVE-2026-131806
events.summary: The CubeWP Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cwp_custom_form[form_data_id]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.13 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce required by the submission handler is publicly emitted in the inline script data of any page rendering the cwpCustomForm shortcode, making it trivially obtainable by unauthenticated visitors and rendering the nonce check ineffective as an authentication barrier.

events.title: CVE-2026-132207
events.summary: The Broken Link Notifier plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content_links[] / header_links[] / footer_links[]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The script executes in the administrator's wp-admin session only when the administrator clicks the Replace Link action on the injected row, meaning successful exploitation requires tricking an administrator into performing that action. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

events.title: CVE-2026-132655
events.summary: The GamiPress – Gamification plugin to reward points, badges & ranks in WordPress, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 8.1.7 via the 'access' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to extract private GamiPress log entries belonging to other users, including admin award, revoke, and event-trigger records marked as private.

events.title: CVE-2026-133404
events.summary: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to modify the XAGIO_SEO_SEARCH_PREVIEW_ENABLE post meta on arbitrary posts, disabling the plugin's SEO title and meta description output for those posts.

events.title: CVE-2026-133405
events.summary: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (metakeyinput=XAGIO_SEO_SCRIPTS_HEADER)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

events.title: CVE-2026-133922
events.summary: The WPFunnels – Funnel Builder for WooCommerce with Checkout & One Click Upsell plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to sensitive information disclosure in versions up to, and including, 3.13.8 This is due to the wpfnl_register_dashboard_widgets() function  registering the 'WPFunnels Overview' dashboard widget on the wp_dashboard_setup hook with no capability check on either the registration or the wpfnl_dashboard_overview_widget() callback, which queries the wpfnl_stats and wpfnl_optin_entries tables and echoes the store's completed-order count, total revenue, order-bump revenue, upsell/downsell revenue and total lead/optin count directly into the dashboard. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above (contributor-level on sites running WooCommerce, where WC_Admin::prevent_admin_access() blocks subscribers from reaching /wp-admin/index.

events.title: CVE-2026-134054
events.summary: The Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access of data due to a missing authorization check on the UACF7_CUSTOM_FIELDS shortcode in versions up to, and including, 3.5.59 The shortcode handler  accepts an attr value of the form 'post_id/meta_key', normalizes the parts with absint() and sanitize_key(), and calls get_post_meta() without verifying that the current user is authorized to read that post (no current_user_can('read_post', $id) or post_status check). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to read arbitrary post meta, including private/draft post meta and third-party plugin PII (e.

events.title: CVE-2026-134058
events.summary: The Premium Packages - Sell Digital Products Securely plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 7.3.4 This is due to the cancel_subscription(), toggleAutoRenew() and toggleManualRenew() AJAX handlers performing no ownership or capability check on the user-supplied `orderid` parameter — the only gate is a plugin-wide NONCE_KEY nonce that is emitted to any visitor on every product page. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to cancel other customers' subscriptions, flip `auto_renew` and toggle the `manual_renew` meta on any order by supplying its ID.

events.title: CVE-2026-135267
events.summary: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'name (REST /wp/v2/tags) / tax_input[post_tag] (post save)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable because WordPress's wp_filter_kses stores entity-encoded payloads (e.g., <img src=x onerror=...>) verbatim as literal text in the database, but Relevanssi's relevanssi_entity_decode() subsequently converts them into live HTML markup before the unescaped return branch of relevanssi_the_tags() splices them into the tag list consumed by the theme.

events.title: CVE-2026-135269
events.summary: The WPC Linked Variation for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wpclv_link[source]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.6.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wpclv custom post type is accessible to Contributor-level users, meaning a Contributor can craft a malicious Linked Variation post whose payload fires in the session of any higher-privileged user (e.g., Administrator or Editor) who opens the post edit screen to review it.

events.title: CVE-2026-135620
events.summary: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to use the found_posts count in the JSON response as a boolean exact-match oracle to confirm specific post meta key/value pairs and enumerate which published posts carry a given meta key, including private underscore-prefixed meta such as API keys, tokens, and plugin configuration secrets.

events.title: CVE-2026-135651
events.summary: The CodeColorer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker has already had one prior comment approved from the same name and email pair, as WordPress's comment_previously_approved check auto-approves subsequent comments from recognized commenters.

events.title: CVE-2026-135655
events.summary: The Easy SwipeBox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'title attribute of <a> inside an approved comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin's default-enabled image autodetection applies the Swipebox handler to all front-end anchor elements whose href matches an image extension — including those inside approved comments — meaning no non-default configuration is required to expose the attack surface. A first-time commenter's submission is held for moderator approval, but once approved the stored payload executes for any user who clicks the image link.

events.title: CVE-2026-135668
events.summary: The Advanced Form Integration — Connect Forms to 300+ Apps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mapped CF7 fields (e.g. target, mkey, payload)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. events.title: CVE-2026-136224
events.summary: The Calculated Fields Form – AI Form Builder for WordPress – Contact, Payment, Quote, Quiz & More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'x' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.6.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Exploitation requires the WordPress site to have a published form configured with a URL-backed text field (using the predefined url.x attribute) wired through a calculated-field equation that calls set_timeslots(); without this non-default form configuration, the vulnerable sink is unreachable.

events.title: CVE-2026-136519
events.summary: The Advanced Product Fields (Product Addons) for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wapf[field_<id>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives sanitization via a whitespace-prefixed tag gadget, is normalized into real HTML elements by wp_kses_post() and force_balance_tags() at render time, and is then executed by WordPress core's tags-box.js when it encounters the forged #tagsdiv-post_tag element on the order screen.

events.title: CVE-2026-136544
events.summary: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Classified ads & Business Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives server-side sanitization because wp_kses_post permits span elements with class and data-* attributes; script execution is triggered only when a privileged user (Administrator or Editor) clicks the .reveal-phone span on the pending listing's preview page, causing rtcl-public.js to pass the attacker-controlled data-options value directly into jQuery.append. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

events.title: CVE-2026-137280
events.summary: The Dashboard Widgets Suite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'dws-notes-user[note]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is exploitable when an Administrator has configured the plugin's Edit Role setting to Subscriber, a documented UI-exposed option, which causes the role check to map to current_user_can('read') — a capability any authenticated Subscriber possesses — and the nonce required by wp_verify_nonce() is legitimately available to the Subscriber on their own dashboard, so no nonce bypass is needed. ✓ Auth empirically confirmed by PoC — reached as Subscriber+.

events.title: CVE-2026-137431
events.summary: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used to handle OpenID Connect authentication flows. The issue occurs because the security check that prevents attackers from pre-seeding security parameters in a redirect URL can be bypassed by adding an extra question mark character to the parameter name. This allows an attacker to trick a user's browser into using an attacker-controlled login code. As a result, a victim may be unknowingly logged into an attacker's account, leading to account confusion or the exposure of sensitive data entered by the victim.

events.title: CVE-2026-137435
events.summary: A flaw was found in the SAML identity brokering component of Keycloak. When Keycloak is configured to use a database with case-insensitive collation, it may incorrectly match a SAML subject name to an existing user account if the names differ only by case. This issue allows an attacker to log in as a different user by providing a case-distinct version of a victim's username in a signed SAML assertion, leading to unauthorized account access.

events.title: CVE-2026-110702
events.summary: The EWWW Image Optimizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.9.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. WordPress core comment kses permits the payload's tag and attribute structure unchanged at save time, meaning the malicious content bypasses save-time sanitization and is only activated when the plugin's output-buffer filter processes the page on render.

events.title: CVE-2026-111846

events.title: CVE-2026-119064
events.summary: The Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based blind SQL Injection via the 'instance[lists]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The wpmlgetlistfields AJAX handler performs only a nonce check with no capability check, and the required refreshfields nonce is emitted on every wp-admin page including /wp-admin/profile.php, making the endpoint trivially reachable by any authenticated Subscriber.

events.title: CVE-2026-119110
events.summary: The Points Management System For Gamification, Ranks, Badges, and Loyalty Rewards Program – myCred plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'key' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Exploitation requires the Link Clicks hook to be enabled and that the attacker, as a Subscriber-level user, can access any front-end page rendering the [mycred_link] shortcode, which localizes the nonce needed to reach the AJAX endpoint.

events.title: CVE-2026-120571
events.summary: The Maps Plugin using Google Maps for WordPress - WP Google Map plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the array keys of the `categories` entries parsed from an imported JSON file in versions up to, and including, 1.9.9 This is due to the wgm_handle_import() function sanitizing only the known-named VALUES (`name`, `icon`) of each category object while passing the attacker-controlled JSON object KEYS directly to `$wpdb->insert()`, which interpolates them as column names into the generated INSERT statement without escaping embedded backticks. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above (when the plugin's own 'Minimum Role for Map Editor' setting has been configured to 'Subscriber', one of five values the plugin's settings UI offers), to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database, including administrator password hashes.

events.title: CVE-2026-120746
events.summary: The MW WP Form plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 5.1.8 via the 'mw-wp-form_session_mw-wp-form-<FORM_ID>' parameter due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to overwrite or delete arbitrary WordPress transients in wp_options — including core-managed transients such as wp_styles_for_blocks — enabling injection of attacker-controlled CSS into every front-end page and permanent anchoring of poisoned transient values that never re-expire. The plugin's CSRF check does not prevent exploitation because MW_WP_Form_Data::__construct() registers _save_to_session() on the PHP shutdown hook before the CSRF check runs, causing the transient write to fire even after wp_safe_redirect()+exit; the GET path via the [mwform_formkey] shortcode has no CSRF check at all.

events.title: CVE-2026-121532
events.summary: The Co-Authors, Multiple Authors and Guest Authors in an Author Box with PublishPress Authors plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'nickname' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.20.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is possible because sanitize_text_field() passes entity-encoded sequences such as < and > through unchanged, allowing a Subscriber to store a breakout payload in their WordPress nickname that is later decoded into live HTML markup by wp_localize_script() and injected into the DOM via jQuery's replaceWith().

events.title: CVE-2026-121978

Successful script execution additionally requires a web server that returns no explicit Content-Type header for the targeted audio/video extension, causing the browser to sniff and render the uploaded file as text/html; default Apache configurations without mod_headers or without honoring .htaccess satisfy this condition. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

events.title: CVE-2026-124840

events.title: CVE-2026-124841
events.summary: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 permits LDAP wildcard characters in legacy GINA identifiers and inserts those values into account, token, certificate, and key lookup filters without escaping. events.title: CVE-2026-124842

A remote attacker who knows the account address can force a reset when a configured administrator or valid stored creator is present, disrupting access and revoking active API tokens; the replacement credential is sent only to a pre-existing trusted recipient.

events.title: CVE-2026-124843

events.title: CVE-2026-124844

events.title: CVE-2026-124845

events.title: CVE-2026-135645
events.summary: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to File Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.4 This is due to the `delete_entry_files()` function gating file cleanup on a loose `preg_match('/signature_/', $meta_key)` substring check against the entry's meta-key rather than verifying the actual field type, which allows an ordinary Text field whose label begins with "Signature" to generate a qualifying meta-key such as `signature_1` — causing the attacker-controlled value submitted via `everest_forms[form_fields][<field_id>]` to be stored verbatim and later passed to `wp_delete_file()`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete files within the `wp-content/uploads/` directory on the server, as `safe_delete_file()` enforces a realpath boundary that prevents deletion of files outside that directory such as `wp-config.php`. Exploitation requires an administrator to permanently delete the attacker's submitted entry, as the unauthenticated attacker cannot trigger the deletion themselves; the targeted file must also reside within `wp-content/uploads/`. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

events.title: CVE-2026-135669

events.title: CVE-2026-136588

events.title: CVE-2026-137284
events.summary: The JetFormBuilder — Dynamic Blocks Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<form-field-name> mapped via Insert/Update Post fields_map (e.g. payload → m_select)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.8.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. events.title: CVE-2026-62272
events.summary:
Relative Path Traversal vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_lambda (ExAws.Lambda module) allows an attacker to redirect an AWS Lambda control-plane request at an unintended resource by injecting path traversal sequences into a caller-supplied identifier.

This vulnerability is associated with program file lib/ex_aws/lambda.ex and program routines ExAws.Lambda.add_permission/5, ExAws.Lambda.delete_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.delete_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function_configuration/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_policy/1, ExAws.Lambda.invoke/4, ExAws.Lambda.invoke_async/2, ExAws.Lambda.remove_permission/2, ExAws.Lambda.update_event_source_mapping/2, ExAws.Lambda.update_function_code/2, ExAws.Lambda.update_function_configuration/2.

ExAws.Lambda builds every request path by interpolating caller-supplied identifiers (function names, ARNs, UUIDs, statement IDs) directly into the URL with plain string interpolation, without percent-encoding or validation. The shared request helper only encodes query parameters, never the path, so path metacharacters such as / and .. reach the wire unchanged. An application that passes an untrusted or user-influenced identifier into an ExAws.Lambda operation can therefore have its request steered at a different Lambda resource: a ../ segment climbs out of the intended /2015-03-31/functions/<name> slot and, once the .. is normalized by the HTTP client or the AWS endpoint, addresses a sibling function in the same account. The signed credentials and the HTTP method are unchanged, so the request still succeeds against the wrong resource. Affected operations include function deletion, invocation, configuration updates, and permission changes. Applications that only pass hardcoded or strictly validated identifiers are not affected.

This issue affects ex_aws_lambda: from 2.0.1 before 2.2.0.

events.title: CVE-2026-86470
events.summary:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB.



Uncontrolled resource consumption in Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB's query API allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause the server to exhaust memory and terminate. A query request can specify an arbitrarily large result limit and offset, which the server uses to pre-allocate result buffers without an upper bound; a single request may force an allocation of tens of gigabytes and cause the process to be killed



This issue affects Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB: from 0.11.0 before 0.11.1.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.11.1, which fixes the issue.

events.title: CVE-2026-110699
events.summary:
Chainlit is vulnerable to a file upload block bypass in the "spontaneous_file_upload" functionality. Disabling the feature with the "enabled = false" option only affects the frontend, while the backend upload endpoints remain active and can be abused directly. An attacker with a valid session ID can send requests to these backend endpoints to upload arbitrary file types and then generate a retrieval URL that is accessible to anyone who obtains the link. This allows the attacker to serve malicious content, such as a fake login pages, from the application's trusted domain, which can be used for phishing attacks against users.




The vulnerability has only been confirmed in versions 2.10.0 and 2.12.0 but may also affect other versions.

events.title: CVE-2026-136760
events.summary:
When authenticating through the Web HMI or Desktop HMI with POSIX LDAP, an attacker can bypass some of Panorama Suite's injection protections. The attacker must know the username and password of a valid account in the LDAP directory. An authenticated attacker may then gain access to areas or business roles they are not authorized to use, or obtain unauthorized permissions in Panorama. Installations that do not use POSIX LDAP authentication are not affected. LDAP Active Directory authentication is not affected.



Affected versions:

  *  Panorama Suite 2020
  *  Panorama Suite 2022-SP1
  *  Panorama Suite 2023
  *  Panorama Suite 2025
  *  Panorama Suite 2025 Updated Dec. 25 (before update PS-2510-02-1317)




Remediation: For Panorama Suite 2025 Updated Dec. 25, install update PS-2510-02-1317 or later. For the other affected versions, upgrade to Panorama Suite 2025 Updated Dec. 25 and install update PS-2510-02-1317 or later.

events.title: CVE-2026-137583

events.title: CVE-2026-137586

events.title: CVE-2026-137587

events.title: CVE-2026-137594
events.summary:
MISP contains an authorization flaw in the SharingGroup model's checkIfAuthorisedExtend method. The method grants sync users (those with the perm_sync role) an exemption from the extend flag requirement when modifying sharing group membership. However, this exemption was applied unconditionally to all sharing groups, including those created locally on the instance (local = 1). The intended behavior, consistent with the sync push path, is that the exemption should only apply to sharing groups received through sync from another instance (local = 0).

As a result, an authenticated sync user whose organization was a plain member (extend flag = 0) of a locally-created sharing group could add or remove organizations and servers from that group via the quick-edit actions or the edit form. This bypassed the extend-flag authorization that is required for non-owner members to modify a sharing group's membership.

Preconditions: the attacker must possess an authenticated account with the sync role (perm_sync) and the sharing group permission (perm_sharing_group), and must be a member of the target locally-created sharing group without the extend flag set. The attacker does not need to be the group owner or a site administrator.

Security impact: an unauthorized modification of sharing group membership can alter which organizations and servers are permitted to exchange threat intelligence data through that group. An attacker could add their own organization to gain access to shared indicators, or remove other organizations to disrupt their data exchange. The scope of impact is limited to the integrity of the sharing group membership configuration and does not directly expose or corrupt stored threat intelligence data.

events.title: CVE-2026-71409
events.summary:
GNU screen is vulnerable to a global buffer overflow in the SendCmdMessage() function within attacher.c. Due to the use of an unchecked sprintf() call when appending the STY environment variable to the global SocketPath buffer. The vulnerability occurs when GNU screen is executed in an environment where the HOME and STY environment variables contain attacker-controlled values that are sufficiently long. Successful exploitation may result in an application crash or potentially arbitrary code execution.


This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

events.title: CVE-2026-71410
events.summary:
GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Use-After-Free in the utf8_handle_comb() function in encoding.c. Due to improper error handling during memory allocation failure, the global combchars pointer is freed but not reset to NULL. When a subsequent combining Unicode character arrives at the terminal, the function dereferences the freed pointer. An attacker who controls terminal content sent to the screen session, such as via a rogue SSH server or crafted escape sequences, can exploit this vulnerability to perform heap grooming and achieve arbitrary code execution.



This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

events.title: CVE-2026-71411
events.summary:
GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Time-of-Check/Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition in the hardcopy file handler. Due to checking write permissions using the real user ID and subsequently opening the file using the effective user ID, a local unprivileged attacker can atomically replace the target path with a symbolic link pointing to an arbitrary system file. Successfully exploiting this race condition allows the attacker to write to arbitrary files with root privileges, leading to local privilege escalation



This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

events.title: CVE-2026-104998
events.summary: The Product Input Fields for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.0 via the process_file_input_field function. This is due to missing file type validation in the process_file_input_field function, which accepts the client-supplied multipart Content-Type header as the sole type gate and writes the uploaded file to the unprotected pif_temp directory using the verbatim client-supplied filename. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. Exploitation requires that an administrator has configured at least one product with a File-type Product Input Field with the "Show thumbnail" option enabled, which is a standard use of the feature; additionally, the pif_temp/ upload directory is created without .htaccess or index.php restrictions, leaving written files directly web-accessible and executable on default Apache/mod_php configurations.

events.title: CVE-2026-107769
events.summary: The Fluent Forms – Customizable Contact Forms, Survey, Quiz, & Conversational Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Account Pre-Hijacking via Unverified Identifier in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.15. The vulnerability exists because the `PaymentHandler::maybeAssignTransactions()` function, registered on the `user_register` hook at priority 99, resolves the lookup email solely from the newly created user record via the `user_email` parameter with no prior verification that the registrant actually controls that address, then bulk-updates all guest transactions and submissions in `wp_fluentform_transactions` and `wp_fluentform_submissions` whose `payer_email` matches and whose `user_id` is NULL to assign ownership to the attacker's new account. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to pre-hijack a victim's prior guest payment history — reading their payment receipts and cancelling their active subscriptions via the `[fluentform_payments]` shortcode and the `wp_ajax_fluentform_user_payment_endpoints` `cancel_transaction` route — by simply registering an account under the victim's email address before the legitimate owner does. Exploitation requires that the WordPress site has open user registration enabled and that the targeted victim previously submitted at least one payment as a guest under their email address.

events.title: CVE-2026-109211
events.summary: The SlimStat Analytics plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'filter_array' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a non-default administrator configuration in which the can_view whitelist contains at least one username of which the attacker's login is a substring (e.g., can_view set to 'trustedreporter' while the attacker's login is 'report'), and the stored payload only fires when an administrator subsequently opens the Saved Filters dialog.

events.title: CVE-2026-109996
events.summary: The LA-Studio Element Kit for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.3 via the 'actions[*][data][autocomplete][query][fields] (and [get_titles][query][fields])' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to extract sensitive user data including password hashes (user_pass), email addresses, and activation keys for all registered accounts including administrators. The elementor_ajax nonce used as the sole access control is available to any logged-in user via the globally exposed elementorCommonConfig JavaScript object, making both AJAX actions trivially reachable at Subscriber privilege level.

events.title: CVE-2026-111803
events.summary: The Email Encoder – Protect Email Addresses and Phone Numbers plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a site administrator to have enabled the plugin's non-default "Protect custom href attributes" setting (e.g. configured to 'tel'), and injected comments must pass standard WordPress moderation before the script executes for visiting users.

events.title: CVE-2026-116565
events.summary: The VK Blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.130.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the moderator to interact with the inline Reply action on the edit-comments screen, which is a routine action triggered when a moderation-held comment is reviewed. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

events.title: CVE-2026-121521
events.summary: The Postie plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'email HTML body' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.91 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable when the processing request runs under a user holding the unfiltered_html capability — either because 'Force User Login' is enabled and Postie switches to the default poster, or because an administrator manually triggers the fetch — causing wp_filter_post_kses to be stripped from content_save_pre and the attribute-breakout markup to be stored verbatim by wp_insert_post().

events.title: CVE-2026-122232
events.summary: The SlimStat Analytics – Real-Time Stats, Heatmaps & Ecommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the non-default 'Show user agent' (slimstat_options[show_complete_user_agent_tooltip]) setting to be enabled, which causes the raw stored User-Agent value to be used as the tooltip title instead of a sanitized browser name.

events.title: CVE-2026-123827
events.summary: The Easy Social Share Buttons for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'position' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 11.6.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload is stored via the unauthenticated wp_ajax_nopriv_ ESSB stat log AJAX action, which performs no nonce or capability check, and executes when the attacker-controlled position value is rendered verbatim into a double-quoted HTML data-* attribute where the unescaped quote allows attribute breakout.

events.title: CVE-2026-125001
events.summary: The NextMove Lite – Thank You Page for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.email' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.24.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected script fires without any victim interaction because the builder page's JavaScript calls $(".preview_order_id").trigger("change") on page load, immediately executing any attribute-injected event handler.

events.title: CVE-2026-126089
events.summary: The Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload (Pro) - WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'wc-upload-file (array key)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires that the site administrator has enabled the 'Count no. of pages?' option (drag_n_drop_count_pdf set to 'yes') and that the uploaded filename stored in the cart resolves to a file with a .pdf extension.

events.title: CVE-2026-130321
events.summary: The PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name / company / address_1 / address_2 / city' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the E-Documents feature to be enabled with a UBL PEPPOL BIS 3.0 format, as that setting is disabled by default and controls whether the vulnerable meta box is registered and rendered.

events.title: CVE-2026-130331
events.summary: The WP Statistics – Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 14.16.19 via the 'tab' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The exploitability of this vulnerability depends on the Minimum Role to View Statistics setting; when set to a low-privilege role such as Subscriber (read capability), unauthenticated-equivalent access is effectively granted to any registered user, while the default Administrator setting limits exposure to higher-privileged accounts.

events.title: CVE-2026-131695
events.summary: The LiteSpeed Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.9.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires CDN Mapping to be enabled with at least one Original URLs entry containing a '*' wildcard character, a non-default configuration; the attacker's comment must also be approved, which is satisfied immediately when moderation is disabled or automatically after one prior approved comment from the same name and email address.

events.title: CVE-2026-132206
events.summary: The Taskbuilder – Project Management & Task Management Tool With Kanban Board plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload fires specifically when an authenticated user with access to the Tasks admin panel applies the 'Created By' filter with the attacker-controlled user selected. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

events.title: CVE-2026-132618
events.summary: The Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that iframe lazy-loading is enabled (the default on new Optimole-connected installs), that the target post contains at least one iframe with fallback text, and that the attacker has had at least one prior comment approved so WordPress's default "Comment author must have a previously approved comment" setting auto-approves subsequent malicious comments.

events.title: CVE-2026-133951
events.summary: The Simple Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in versions up to, and including, 4.8.9 This is due to the site-wide signing secret `swpm_private_key_one` being generated at install time with PHP's non-cryptographic `uniqid('', true)` function in `SwpmInstallation::installer()`, whose timestamp-derived keyspace (~10^15 candidates / ~50 bits) can be constrained via the public WordPress REST API date of the plugin's auto-created registration page, combined with a single-MD5 oracle (`md5(key|level)`) that the public registration form prints as `swpm_level_hash` and a non-constant-time `!=` comparison in `SwpmFrontRegistration::register_front_end()` as the sole authorization gate on which membership level a visitor may register into; `SwpmUtils::get_free_level()` then honors an attacker-posted `level_identifier=md5(level)` regardless of the configured free-membership setting, and `prepare_and_create_wp_user_front_end()` creates the WordPress account with whatever role the level is configured to grant (only the `administrator` role is refused). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers, after an offline brute-force recovery of the install-time secret against the public MD5 oracle, to forge a valid `swpm_level_hash` for any configured membership level and self-register into that level, elevating their newly created WordPress account to the level's assigned role — e. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete editor role.

events.title: CVE-2026-134173
events.summary: The WordPress File Upload plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Deletion in versions up to, and including, 5.3.1 via the 'wfu_ajax_action_handshake' and 'wfu_ajax_action_send_email_notification' AJAX Actions. This is due to the unauthenticated handshake accepting a 'sid' parameter sanitized only with sanitize_text_field(), which does not strip '[', ']', '{', or '}', allowing the sid to be crafted as an item name containing embedded delimiter pairs that plant forged records for arbitrary other item names — including the per-session file path list and the consent flag — in the plugin's shared concatenated user-state option store, combined with the notification handler being gated only by a nonce freely minted by the same nopriv handshake. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the affected site's server which may make remote code execution possible.

events.title: CVE-2026-134175
events.summary: The WP Review Slider plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Read in versions up to, and including, 15.5 via the wprp_twitter_savetweet and wpfb_avatar_tolocal AJAX actions. This is due to the handlers only verifying a WordPress nonce without any current_user_can() capability check and accepting an attacker-supplied local filesystem path in the 'tw_img' parameter, which is later passed directly to PHP's copy() to write byte-identical data into a publicly accessible uploads directory under an attacker-chosen name. The nonce action 'randomnoncestring' is shared with the same vendor's companion plugin (WP Google Review Slider), which emits it to every visitor of every front-end page, making it obtainable by any logged-in user including Subscribers whenever that companion plugin is active. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to read arbitrary files on the affected site's server, including sensitive files such as wp-config.

events.title: CVE-2026-135035
events.summary: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WPtouch WPtouch wptouch allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WPtouch: from n/a through 4.3.62.

events.title: CVE-2026-135641
events.summary: The WP Job Portal – AI-Powered Recruitment System for Company or Job Board website plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.2 This is due to a flaw in `WPJOBPORTALuser::__construct()` where the non-empty guard on the `wpjobportal-socialid` cookie is evaluated against the raw cookie value before `sanitize_key()` is applied — allowing a value composed entirely of characters outside `[a-z0-9_-]` to pass the guard, be reduced to an empty string by `sanitize_key()`, and be used as the literal value in a `WHERE socialid = ''` database query that matches the first portal account whose `socialid` column is empty. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to be bound to an existing WP Job Portal Employer or Jobseeker account, gaining the ability to create, edit, and delete the victim's companies, job listings, resumes, and applications, as well as overwrite the linked WordPress user's first name, last name, and display name via the `saveuser`→`syncWPUserName()` path. Exploitation is viable on virtually all installations because every portal account not registered through the social-login flow retains the default empty `socialid` value; nonce checks on downstream actions such as `savecompany` and `saveuser` do not mitigate this issue because those nonces are minted within the already-hijacked session and validate against the attacker's own subsequent requests. Successful exploitation gives the attacker control of a distinct, already-privileged WP Job Portal Employer / Jobseeker (bound to a specific WordPress user) account; it does not promote the attacker's original account.

events.title: CVE-2026-135654
events.summary: The Lightbox with PhotoSwipe plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.18.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires an administrator to approve the attacker's comment at least once, which is the default WordPress behavior for first-time commenters; after that initial approval, no further administrative action is needed and the payload fires for any visitor who opens the lightbox on the affected post.

events.title: CVE-2026-135675
events.summary: The RSS Aggregator by Feedzy – Feed to Post, Autoblogging, News & YouTube Video Feeds Aggregator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in versions up to, and including, 5.2.17 due to insufficient restriction on the wp_kses_allowed_html filter callback. The feedzy_wp_kses_allowed_html() method is registered on wp_kses_allowed_html with the loader's default accepted_args=1, so the callback never receives the context-name argument and unconditionally adds <iframe> (with arbitrary src, width, height, frameborder, allowfullscreen and data-* attributes) to the allowed-tag array for every context — including pre_comment_content, which WordPress uses to sanitize comment bodies submitted by users without the unfiltered_html capability. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

events.title: CVE-2026-136211
events.summary: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'REQUEST_URI' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution of the injected script requires an administrator to use the plugin's own "Add 301 Redirect" workflow on the attacker's logged 404 row, which causes the entity-laundered double quote to be written into the redirects table and subsequently rendered unescaped in the administrator's browser. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

events.title: CVE-2026-136212
events.summary: The LA-Studio Element Kit for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'actions[].data.settings.triggers.scrolling_to_selector' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The elementor_ajax nonce required to reach the handler is printed in elementorCommonConfig on every wp-admin page, making it trivially obtainable by any logged-in Subscriber via /wp-admin/profile.php; although Elementor's attribute escaping is applied at render time, the stored selector value is subsequently passed to jQuery() by the popup frontend script, which re-parses strings beginning with '<' as HTML, bypassing the escaping.

events.title: CVE-2026-136240
events.summary: The PDF Invoice for WooCommerce + Drag and Drop Template Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 7.2.0 via deserialization of untrusted input . This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present. The incomplete remediation in version 7.2.0 applied escape_pdf_note() only to the customer_note path; the billing address path at woocommerce/shortcodes.php:975–978 remains unpatched, and exploitation requires guest checkout to be enabled along with a payment method that transitions orders to on-hold status (such as the stock WooCommerce Direct Bank Transfer option).

events.title: CVE-2026-136462
events.summary: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that at least one prior comment from the attacker's email address has been manually approved, which under WordPress's default comment_previously_approved=1 setting causes subsequent comments from that address to be auto-approved without moderation.

events.title: CVE-2026-136488
events.summary: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'stype' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. This is possible because the plugin's mu-plugin companion (copied automatically on install when the default 'Enable Fast AJAX' option is on) defines DOING_AJAX on any front-end request carrying gd-ajax=1, and an unconditional branch in geodir_get_current_posttype() restores the attacker-controlled stype value after the allow-list check clears it, allowing the tainted value to reach the SQL sink without any preparation.

events.title: CVE-2026-136517
events.summary: The UsersWP – Front-end login form, User Registration, User Profile & Members Directory plugin for WP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the '<htmlvar_name> of any editor-type Account field (e.g. about_work)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.83 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has configured at least one editor-type Account field with public visibility and directory display enabled, as no such field exists in a default installation.

events.title: CVE-2026-136596
events.summary: The GD bbPress Tools plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'signature' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The crafted signature payload is stored verbatim in user meta and fires when an Administrator views the attacker's topic on the Edit Topic admin screen.

events.title: CVE-2026-136607
events.summary: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.208 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to have previously configured a Shortcode-type tab whose template places %%post_content%% inside an HTML attribute, which is not a default configuration; unauthenticated exploitation additionally requires the plugin's 'Allow posting without logging in?' option and WordPress user registration to both be enabled.

events.title: CVE-2026-136610
events.summary: The Pixeline’s Email Protector plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires the malicious comment to pass the site's moderation queue, which WordPress enforces for first-time commenters by default but which does not re-sanitize stored comment content.

events.title: CVE-2026-137119
events.summary: The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<form_field_slug>[] (array-valued post field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the BuddyForms form to have public submission enabled, which allows unauthenticated visitors to submit forms; the _wpnonce required by the form handler is printed in the public form HTML and is therefore accessible to any visitor, providing no meaningful authorization barrier.

events.title: CVE-2026-137122
events.summary: The PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.address_1' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit requires the E-Documents feature to be enabled with a document format selected, as this is what causes the vulnerable meta box to be rendered on the order edit screen.

events.title: CVE-2026-137404
events.summary: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file food-search.php of the component Food Search. The manipulation of the argument Search leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

events.title: CVE-2026-93087
events.summary: A maliciously modified field in the locally stored JSON description for an update made available by Autodesk, when processed by Autodesk Access, can cause attacker-controlled HTML content to be executed in another user's session. A local, authenticated malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of another user if that user interacts with an injected link, resulting in privilege escalation.

events.title: CVE-2026-95810
events.summary: The Easy Form Builder by WhiteStudio – Drag & Drop Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via esign 'value' Field via Cross-Type 'r_matrix' Poisoning in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation is possible without authentication because the REST endpoint /wp-json/Emsfb/v1/forms/message/add is guarded only by a wp_rest nonce freely obtainable by any visitor loading the public-facing form page via efb_var.nonce.

events.title: CVE-2026-96555
events.summary: The Asset CleanUp Pro: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via 'author_name' URL segment (author archive rewrite capture) in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.8.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

events.title: CVE-2026-103886
events.summary: The App Builder – Create Native Android & iOS Apps On The Flight plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Google ID Token Audience Validation Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.7.1. This is due to the `LoginGoogle::login()` function failing to validate the `aud` (audience) claim of the supplied `idToken` against any OAuth client ID belonging to the WordPress site, failing to verify the `email_verified` claim, and resolving WordPress accounts solely by the email claim without binding to the Google `sub` (subject) identifier — while the `/app-builder/v1/login` REST endpoint is registered with a `permission_callback` that unconditionally returns `true`, leaving it fully reachable by unauthenticated requesters. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as any existing WordPress user — including Administrators — whose email address is known, by supplying a Google-signed ID token obtained from an entirely unrelated OAuth client containing the target user's email claim, which causes the plugin to issue a signed App Builder JWT granting that user's full privileges. Exploitation requires the attacker to obtain a valid Google-signed ID token carrying the target user's email address, which can be achieved by operating a separate Google OAuth client and inducing the target user to authenticate through it.

events.title: CVE-2026-107626
events.summary: The WebP Express plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.25.15 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.
